description: Defines the interface for the SSB processor and its validator in a 5G NR context, including data structures for PDU and processing methods.

classes.name: ssb_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) PDUs in 5G NR, including a process method.

classes.name: ssb_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating SSB processor configuration parameters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the SS/PBCH Block PDU and writes the signal into the resource grid.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the parameters of the SS/PBCH Block PDU for the given carrier bandwidth.
